text:
Pradeep: Quick heads-up — need a fast decision on what's in MVP vs v1 for telemetry rollout. Meeting tomorrow 10am. Root ask: can we ship MVP without SSO and full observability? cc @Marta @Alex
Marta: Agree we should trim non-blocking UX. SSO is risky — have we quantified customer impact?
Alex: Sales said Enterprise A requires SSO or won't pilot. But we can do a limited canary for other tenants.
Jen: Customer-ACME flagged SSO as must-have for pilot. If we cut SSO, we lose pilot. :grimacing:
Sam: If we keep SSO, we add ~2 sprints for infra + e2e. Otherwise, +1 sprint to stabilize telemetry.
Pradeep: Proposal: ship MVP without global SSO, enable tenant-scoped SSO in canary for 2 pilot customers. SSO moves to v1. Rollout plan:
Pradeep: ```
- MVP: core inference routes, basic telemetry, per-tenant canary SSO for ACME & BetaCo
- v1: full SSO + expanded observability dashboards
- Freeze date: 1709220000 (next Wed) for MVP features
- Owners: Marta (scope), Alex (sales/pilot), Sam (infra)
```
Marta: I'll add a cutlist doc and short rationale. link: https://redwood.internal/notes/scope-cuts
Alex: I'll confirm ACME pilot acceptance for canary. If they require full SSO, we'll escalate.
Jen: If ACME can't pilot w/o SSO, we have two options: (1) delay MVP by 2 sprints, (2) accept smaller pilot cohort. pref (2).
Sam: Note: adding tenant-scoped SSO requires config isolation + KMS keys. ETA: 1 sprint for core, 1 for e2e.
Pradeep: Decision for tomorrow: keep SSO for MVP? vote with emoji please. I'll compile and publish action items after meeting. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: canary-policy created for 'mvp-sso-canary' — owners: Alex, Sam
Marta: +1 to canary route. I'll author the cutlist tonight and tag owners.
Alex: 👍
Jen: :thumbsup:
Pradeep: Thanks everyone. Meeting 10am — I'll post final cutlist after.
